title: Stellarium Session Daily Event Volume
dataSources: Observatory environment (`observatory:env`), sky-quality meter (`skyquality:reading`), imaging sessions (`imaging:session`), telescope mount (`mount:status`), cloud sensor (`allsky:cloud`).
app: Backyard observatory automation — roll-off-roof/dome controller, sky-quality meter, cloud sensor, telescope mount, and astrophotography software (N.I.N.A./Ekos) — via MQTT and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=stellarium:session
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as events, dc(target_name) as distinct_entities by _time
| sort - _time
description: Counts how many Stellarium session events land each day and how many distinct target values are represented.
value: Daily volume is the fastest way to spot a dead feed, a sudden burst, or a workflow that quietly changed.
implementation: Ingest Stellarium session records into `index=personal`; schedule daily and compare count and distinct target values against your normal baseline.
visualization: Column chart of daily event count with a line for distinct entities.
grandmaExplanation: It scores how much Stellarium session activity showed up each day so you can see if the feed went quiet or suddenly got busy.
